fairUse.title: Politique d’usage équitable
fairUse.updated: S’applique à tous les utilisateurs de Pricefly.
fairUse.p1: Pricefly est destiné à un usage personnel et non abusif. Nous pouvons limiter, ralentir ou suspendre les comptes qui génèrent un trafic automatisé excessif, surchargent notre infrastructure ou nuisent à d’autres utilisateurs.
fairUse.p2: Les notifications par e-mail sont facultatives et plafonnées selon l’offre : jusqu’à 2 produits en gratuit et 10 en Pro. Les notifications in-app et push web ne sont pas soumises à ces plafonds e-mail par produit.
fairUse.p3: Vous vous engagez à ne pas abuser du service : pas de contournement des limites, pas de scraping non autorisé de l’API, pas d’utilisation de Pricefly pour harceler autrui.
fairUse.li1: Respectez robots.txt et les conditions de chaque boutique pour les URL produits.
fairUse.li3: Nous pouvons modifier cette politique ; l’utilisation continue vaut acceptation de la version en vigueur.
fairUse.p4: Questions ? Contactez-nous via le support indiqué sur le site.

hero.title: Track camera & tech prices —
hero.sub: Pricefly uses prices from a partner product catalog. Search for a product, add it, and optionally set price thresholds plus email or push notifications. Automatic checks run once per day for all products together; you can also refresh any item manually at any time.

steps.title: How Pricefly actually works
steps.sub: Three steps as in the app — no buzzwords.

step1.title: 1. Find a product in the catalog
step1.body: Search by name, keyword, or a shop URL from the feed, then pick a result. Data comes from your imported partner catalog — not arbitrary store URLs.

step2.title: 2. Set alerts (optional)
step2.body: Choose lower and/or upper price limits and enable email or system notifications (Web Push) where your plan and server configuration allow.

step3.title: 3. Follow the price and buy
step3.body: We refresh all active catalog trackings once per day. You can refresh manually anytime. Purchase via the merchant link shown in the app.

facts.title: What the app really offers
facts.a: Prices from the imported partner catalog — not “paste any URL and scrape the page”.
facts.b: Automatic check once per day for all products; you choose the time of day and time zone in the app.
facts.d: Plan limits (e.g. number of trackings, email alerts) — see Pricing.

cta.title: Ready?
cta.sub: Sign up free, search the catalog, and set price alerts.
cta.note: No credit card required to get started. Terms and privacy policy apply.

affiliate.title: Affiliate note:
affiliate.body: Offers may use affiliate programs; that usually does not change the price you pay. The app uses your imported feed — we do not pick products by commission in the UI.
